messages:
sara: Quick sync: after the RFC, ops wants a minimal, auditable handoff primitive for active/active that never silently moves secrets across regions. Need a low-risk design we can roll out fast.

mike: We saw a near miss when an autoscaler prewarmed NA for EU tenants. Proposal: make prewarm a two-phase operation: metadata-only pass + optional secrets pass gated by explicit consent.

leila: Add to that: produce a delta report in prepare step listing items that will require secret hydration (size + keys). That gives operators a clear acceptance gate.

tom: Implementation thought: issue ephemeral tokens: dry_token for metadata, prewarm_token for secrets. Both scoped to lease and region. Data plane only accepts requests with either token. No token == reject.

sara: Good. Tokens must include claims: tenant_id, lease_id, target_region, consent_level. Validate X-Target-Region header matches token.

mike: KMS constraint: never allow our control-plane to return raw keys. For secrets hydration either ask customer to grant delegated KMS access in target region or require them to rewrap blobs for us. Document both.

leila: Observability: emit events for prepare.completed, prewarm.started, prewarm.failed with token ids and operator id. Also log dry-run CSV as an artifact.

ops-bot: infra-bot: created feature-flag "handoff-safeguards" in staging.

tom: Edge-case: token introspection may fail during network partitions. Data plane should cache token verification for short TTL (30s) and fail closed for secret-stage.

sara: Rollout plan: start with non-PII tenants behind flag, run canary for 48h, then expand. Add runbook: if secret hydration fails, abort commit and notify compliance owner.

mike: Add error codes in RFC: 403 CONSENT_MISSING, 410 TOKEN_EXPIRED, 409 REGION_MISMATCH, 424 HYDRATION_BLOCKED.

leila: I'll mock the dry-run UI and CSV export. Tom will prototype token minting in lease-manager. Sara will write the short RFC with API samples and headers.

sara: Thanks. Goal: make operator handoffs explicit, auditable, and safe for residency customers. Closing; RFC PR incoming.
